Below is a quick‑reference snapshot of eBay UK’s fee structure for selling clothing (apparel & accessories).  
These figures are the most recent public rates (2024‑25) and are rounded to the nearest pence; real‑world totals may vary slightly for things like additional services (i.e., PayPal‑like payment processing within eBay’s “Managed Payments”, optional “Store” subscriptions, promotions, etc.).

| **Fee Type** | **What it Applies To** | **Amount (UK)** | **Comments / Notes** |
|--------------|------------------------|-----------------|----------------------|
| **Insertion fee (first 50 listings in a listing period)** | Listing a new item for sale | **Free** | Unlimited for the first 50 (per month) across all categories; can exceed 50 by paying a flat fee per extra listing (usually £0.35‑£1.10). |
| **Reserve fee** | Setting a minimum price you’re willing to accept | **£0.25** (per listing) | Optional. |
| **Final Value Fee (FVF)** | Percent of the sale price (plus shipping, customs, and any optional services) | **13 % + £0.80 per item sold** | Reduced rate (**8 % + £0.80**) for “fewer than 100 UK sellers monthly”; 10 % for newer sellers or if you don’t meet the "sold in the last 30 days" threshold.  Applicable to the **total** of item price + shipping + tax + any optional services. |
| **Paid Returns Fee** | Returned items ordered by buyer | **£1.70** per item | Only when the buyer pays for return postage (seller‑funded). |
| **PayPal‑like Credit/Debit Card fee (Managed Payments)** | When the buyer pays with a card via eBay’s “Managed Payments” | **2.9 % + £0.20 per transaction** | Charged in addition to the FVF.  eBay now channels most UK payments through Managed Payments; older PayPal accounts can still be used but the fee structure may differ. |
| **Promotional fees** | “Buy It Now”, “Best Offer”, “Collectibles & Luxury Items” etc. | Varies (typically 2–6 % of final sale price) | Some promotions may add a separate “promotion” fee or are built into the FVF. |
| **Store Subscription (optional)** | Monthly fee for Seller Store (benefits: below‑FVF fees, additional analytics, etc.) | £25–£65 / month (depending on Tier) | “Starter” tier: 1 % FVF on items; “Basic”: 0.5 % on 1–150 items per month; “Premium”: 0.25 % on 1–300 items; “Enterprise”: 0.1 % on 1–1,000 items. |
| **Item title & description extra words** | Over‑length titles ( > 80 characters) or long descriptions | Additional small charge (£0.25‑£0.50) | If you exceed eBay’s allowed limits. |
| **Fixed‑price listing “Storefront” feature** | Special placement in Storefront or “Category feature” | £3–£7 per listing | Requires a Store subscription. |

### How it works in practice (example)

| Item | Listing price | Shipping | Final Value fee (13 %) | Manage‑Pay card fee (2.9 % + £0.20) | Total seller fees |
|------|---------------|----------|------------------------|-------------------------------------|-------------------|
| T‑shirt | £20.00 | £3.00 | £3.25 (13% of £23) | £0.75 (~2.9% of £20 + £0.20) | **£4.00** |

If you subscribed to a Seller Store with a 1 % FVF discount, the FVF would be reduced to £2.30, and the card fee would still apply.  
Remember: fees are calculated on the **final sale price (item + shipping + tax)**.

### Quick Tips to Minimise Fees

1. **Add shipping to the final price** – FVF is on the total, so you can offset it w/ a decent shipping charge (but keep it reasonable to avoid deterring buyers).  
2. **Use a Seller Store** – Even a Starter tier dramatically cuts the FVF for each sale and unlocks other benefits (e.g., analytics, inventory management).  
3. **Bundle items** – If you can sell a bundle (e.g., a graphic tee + accessory) as one listing, you pay one FVF instead of multiple.  
4. **Use eBay’s “Promotions” wisely** – The 2–6 % promotion fee may be cheaper than the 13 % FVF if the item sells for a low price.  
5. **Encourage “Buy It Now”** – It removes the negotiation “Best Offer” fee (10 %) and triggers the lower FVF.

### Bottom line

For a typical single clothing item (e.g., a tee) sold in the UK:

- **Insertion** → Free (first 50 listings).  
- **Final Value** → 13 % of item + shipping + tax (~£4 on a £20 tee).  
- **Card payment** → 2.9 % of item + £0.20 (~£0.75).  
- **Total** → Roughly 17–18 % of the sale price (excluding optional store discounts).

Keep an eye on eBay’s help pages; they periodically update fee structures and thresholds. Happy selling at Faded Archive!
